Mia Chen: Heads-up — OrchidAI reached out about onboarding their 'orchid-XL' family. They want retail distribution via AWS & GCP marketplaces and a joint announcement. Need quick alignment on redistribution rights and license. Threading in legal & partnerships.
Alex Rivera: Nice. Do we have their license? Is it permissive (Apache/MIT) or something else?
Mia Chen: They've attached a custom dual-license: permissive on model code, but weights under 'Orchid Research License v1' — non-derivative redistribution clause. They want us to host quantized weights behind Redwood Dedicated & Private, but restrict resale.
Samir Patel: Non-derivative distribution means we can serve but not redistribute the weights, right? Need legal confirmation. @Elaine Wong can you weigh in?
Elaine Wong: Correct, non-derivative typically allows serving (SaaS) but forbids resale or rehosting with redistribution. But wording matters — need to see the exact clause. Upload the CLA snippet or link.
Mia Chen: Pasting the license excerpt: 
```
Orchid Research License v1: Redistribution of model weights or checkpoints is prohibited. Hosting for inference (SaaS) is allowed provided attribution included and usage telemetry shared monthly.
```
Mia Chen: They also request we list them on marketplaces; Orchid expects to be co-vendor on AWS/GCP listings. Marketplace requires EULA, support contact, and security attestation.
Alex Rivera: Marketplace point: our cloud marketplace team needs a rehost/right-to-distribute stamp. If weights can't be redistributed, co-vendor listing is still possible if Orchid is the listing owner and we provide hosted API linking to their listing. Need to check marketplace policies.
Samir Patel: Action items: (1) Legal to confirm 'serve-only' ok for Hosted & Dedicated. (2) Marketplace team to confirm co-vendor path w/o weight redistribution. (3) Product to ensure UI shows attribution + telemetry toggle. (4) Marketing for joint announcement draft.
PartnerBot: Created ticket #PRT-4827 for 'OrchidAI onboarding — licensing + marketplace'. Assignee: Alex Rivera. Due: 2026-04-15.
Alex Rivera: I'll take #PRT-4827. I'll ping CloudMarketplace eng leads; @Elaine Wong can you confirm legal by EOD Friday?
Elaine Wong: I'll review and add redlines. Likely ask Orchid to clarify telemetry data fields and retention. Also check dataset provenance clause for training data.
Mia Chen: Orchid expects a co-branded launch in late April. Can marketing commit to a short announcement if legal + marketplace clearances done by 4/12?
Elaine Wong: Tentatively yes pending redlines.
Samir Patel: Technical checklist for eng-runtime: ensure quantized artifact storage is separated (no direct download), signing of model bundles, and telemetry hooks with per-partner opt-in. I can draft infra requirements.
Mia Chen: Great. Let's treat this as high priority — Orchids have good traction. I'll follow up with Orchids to request full license text + dataset provenance statement. We'll update #PRT-4827 as we get responses.
Alex Rivera: Thanks all. @Elaine Wong please add required legal flags to the ticket. I'll coordinate marketplace contact. :thumbsup:
